panels.description: TJ's lost leg sinks among old mine rails beneath Lake Keel. Keep the leg isolated against dark water; leave upper water clear for the sound.
The tanker becomes a distant light while the damaged drone sparks above the water. Leave open darkness around both objects.
Older Alex stands rigid at the shore while his granddaughter looks from him toward TJ's head. Keep the boathouse wall behind them as shelter and leave upper space for dialogue.
The lost leg's magnet pulses in the darkness among the rails. Keep the small light isolated and leave black negative space around it.

items.speaker: ALEX
items.text: Not without making the lake a battlefield.
